description: Convert one DICOM series folder to a compressed NIfTI volume plus its BIDS JSON sidecar with dcm2niix (Chris Rorden; the converter used by lightNIIng, BIDSvue and most BIDS converters). Expects the folder to hold a single series; a multi-echo series yields its first echo as the volume and leaves the others in the step's output directory.

dicom_dir.description: Folder of DICOM files for one series.

volume.description: Converted NIfTI volume (gzip), RAS-reoriented by dcm2niix.

sidecar.description: BIDS JSON sidecar: sequence, timing, and acquisition metadata.

block.label: DICOM to NIfTI (dcm2niix)
block.description: Convert a DICOM series to NIfTI + JSON.

neuroflow/launch.description: Runs dcm2niix -z y -f volume -o <outputDir> <dicom_dir> through the shared native CLI adapter.

useWhen: Convert one DICOM series folder to a single NIfTI volume plus its BIDS JSON sidecar.
A next step needs one volume (e.g. a T1 for skull stripping or segmentation) rather than a BIDS dataset.

avoidWhen.when: The folder holds a whole session or several series and you want a BIDS dataset.
The sequence names follow ReproIn and you want HeuDiConv's BIDS layout.
You need every echo of a multi-echo series as an output: only the first echo is returned (the others stay in the output directory).

preconditions: dcm2niix on PATH, in /usr/local/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin or ~/fsl/bin, or set via DCM2NIIX. JPEG Lossless DICOM needs a 2026-05-20 or newer build.
dicom_dir holds the files of exactly one series.
effects: Writes volume*.nii.gz and volume*.json to the output directory and returns the first of each; dicom_dir is not changed.
The sidecar is anonymized (-ba y) unless anonymize is false.

duration.basis: Measured over 10 gallery runs on an Apple-silicon Mac: median 0.3 s for one T1 series; the slowest took 61 s.

examples.title: Keep acquisition dates in the sidecar

failures.remedy: Install dcm2niix (e.g. brew install dcm2niix), or set DCM2NIIX to its path.

failures.meaning: dcm2niix could not convert this folder, e.g. no readable DICOM or an unsupported transfer syntax.
failures.remedy: Read the step log. Check dicom_dir with neuroflow_inspect; for JPEG Lossless data update dcm2niix.

failures.meaning: dcm2niix ran but wrote no NIfTI, so the folder held no image series.
failures.remedy: Point dicom_dir at a folder that contains one image series.
